newsitem.title: USA: El Paso N.M. gas plant work to cut supply.
newsitem.headline: El Paso N.M. gas plant work to cut supply.

text.p: El Paso Energy said Wednesday that scheduled maintenance this week at its Chaco gas processing plant in northwestern New Mexico will cut some of its supply from the San Juan basin.

"It was scheduled. The plant will be down from July 24 starting at 7 A.M. (MDT) through July 28 and will impact San Juan supply by about 400 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd)," a company spokesman said.
He said El Paso's scheduled supply from San Juan this month is about 2.6 billion cubic feet per day.
